content:
We need to return mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule (given as input data), reproduces the reaction described: Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons (HWE) reaction, forming olefin, breaking C-P and C-O bonds, forming aliphatic carboxylic acid and C=C double bonds.

We have previous step: make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1 gave precursors list (three possible). Those are the precursors from applying some template to the target molecule. We need to find the template that was used, and return its mapped_rxn and template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). So we need to identify which template corresponds to HWE reaction.

We have the precursors list: each is a SMILES string. Let's examine them.

Precursors:

1. "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO"
2. "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO"
3. "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"

These look like the target molecule is a protected form of a phosphonate? Actually HWE uses a phosphonate ester (e.g., diethyl phosphonoacetate) reacting with aldehyde to give alkene and phosphate byproduct. The target product is an olefin with a carboxylic acid (maybe after deprotection). The precursors likely are the phosphonate ester and the aldehyde.

But the given precursors are all similar: they seem to be the same core but with silyl protecting groups on either the carboxylate or the alcohol? Actually they have O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C which is a tert-butyldimethylsilyl (TBS) group? O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C is maybe a TBDMS? Actually TBDMS is OSi(CH3)2C(CH3)3. So yes.

Thus the template likely is a HWE reaction where a phosphonate (with OSi protecting) reacts with an aldehyde to give the alkene and a phosphate byproduct (maybe not shown). The template ID we need to retrieve.

We need to search template catalog by criteria: functional_groups_broken: "C-P", "C-O"? functional_groups_formed: "C-C double bond", "aliphatic carboxylic acid". Also bonds formed: "6-6"? Not sure.

We can use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with appropriate criteria. Let's try.
